name: Tardigrade Swarm

items.name: Eyespots
items.text: A tardigrade swarm can't see anything beyond 30 feet.

items.name: Tun Marbles
items.text: As the tardigrade swarm is damaged, the bodies of those that enter a tun state make the ground treacherous. When the tardigrade swarm drops below 70 Hit Points, the space they occupy is considered difficult terrain.

items.name: Stylets
items.text: Each enemy in the swarm's space takes 4d8 piercing damage (DC 32 basic Reflex save save). Creatures that fail their save become Drained 1 or increase their drained condition by one, to a maximum of drained 4.

text: Tardigrades grow no larger than the width of a hair, but when their riverside environments are exposed to heightened levels of magic, these eight-legged omnivores can grow to tremendous sizes.
